prayerExcerpt.en-US: Whoever loves me will be loved by my Father.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Aquele que me ama será amado por meu Pai.

meta.face: A Sudanese woman of about fifty with deep dark-brown skin, a round, full face, a broad nose and full lips, large, gentle dark eyes and a warm, open smile; no marks on the face.
meta.basis: Her photographs (c. 1910 and the colour portrait) in the Canossian habit and ruffled bonnet with the Sorrowful Mother medal; Schio remembered her 'ever-present smile', and called her 'Madre Moretta'. The broken chain is the usual modern emblem of the slave set free.
meta.excerpt: content/of/formularies/common/virgins/virg0.json communionAntiphon (first sentence; en-US cut at 'Father'). Her feast has no proper formulary in the repo.
